entities.summary: The Taganrog Drama Theater named after Anton Chekhov and decorated with Order of Honor is a traditional Russian drama theater based in Taganrog, Rostov Oblast. Chekov Theatre is a theatre building in Europe, established in 1827. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
